alt.en: The worn, stained paper cover of a booklet inside a ruled border, printed in capitals: "Jubilee Songs: as sung by the Jubilee Singers, of Fisk University, (Nashville, Tenn.) under the auspices of the American Missionary Association. Price 25 cents. New York: Published by Biglow & Main, 425 Broome St. Chicago: 726 Wabash Av." A faint pencilled note runs along the top edge.
alt.es: La cubierta de papel, gastada y manchada, de un cuadernillo, dentro de un marco de líneas, impresa en mayúsculas: "Jubilee Songs: as sung by the Jubilee Singers, of Fisk University, (Nashville, Tenn.) under the auspices of the American Missionary Association. Price 25 cents. New York: Published by Biglow & Main, 425 Broome St. Chicago: 726 Wabash Av." Una nota tenue a lápiz recorre el borde superior.

caption.en: The cover of Jubilee Songs (New York, 1872), the book made from the Fisk singers' own singing: its page 6 is the earliest known printing of Swing Low with its music.
caption.es: La cubierta de Jubilee Songs (Nueva York, 1872), el libro hecho a partir del propio canto de los cantantes de Fisk: su página 6 es la primera impresión conocida de Swing Low con su música.

source: Jubilee songs: as sung by the Jubilee Singers of Fisk University (Nashville, Tenn.) under the auspices of the American Missionary Association (New York: Biglow & Main, 1872), front cover

alt.en: A printed page headed "6" and "Jubilee Songs.", titled "Swing Low, sweet Chariot." in black-letter type: five lines of music on paired staves in 2/4, with the refrain and verses 1 and 2 under the notes, the lower staff resting under some phrases, and verses 3 and 4 printed in two columns at the foot.
alt.es: Página impresa con el encabezado "6" y "Jubilee Songs.", titulada "Swing Low, sweet Chariot." en letra gótica: cinco sistemas de música en pares de pentagramas en 2/4, con el estribillo y las estrofas 1 y 2 bajo las notas, el pentagrama inferior en silencio bajo algunas frases, y las estrofas 3 y 4 impresas en dos columnas al pie.

caption.en: Page 6 of Jubilee Songs (1872), the earliest known printing of Swing Low with its music: the lower staff is silent on each call, and every part comes in on "Coming for to carry me home".
caption.es: La página 6 de Jubilee Songs (1872), la primera impresión conocida de Swing Low con su música: el pentagrama inferior calla en cada llamada, y todas las voces entran en "Coming for to carry me home".

source: Jubilee songs: as sung by the Jubilee Singers of Fisk University (New York: Biglow & Main, 1872), p. 6, "Swing Low, sweet Chariot"

alt.en: A black-and-white photograph of a tall brick Victorian Gothic building with rows of arched windows, dormers in a steep slate roof, tall chimneys and a pointed open bell tower, seen across a lawn and a curving drive between trees and clipped shrubs.
alt.es: Fotografía en blanco y negro de un alto edificio de ladrillo de estilo neogótico victoriano, con hileras de ventanas en arco, buhardillas en un tejado empinado de pizarra, altas chimeneas y un campanario abierto y puntiagudo, visto al otro lado de un césped y un camino curvo, entre árboles y arbustos recortados.

caption.en: Jubilee Hall at Fisk University, photographed for the Historic American Buildings Survey in 1970: named for the Jubilee Singers and built with money their tours raised, it was dedicated on 1 January 1876.
caption.es: Jubilee Hall, en la Universidad Fisk, fotografiado para el Historic American Buildings Survey en 1970: lleva el nombre de los Jubilee Singers, se construyó con el dinero que reunieron sus giras y se inauguró el 1 de enero de 1876.
